profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary:
James Martinez sharpened his technical skills and natural entrepreneurial abilities during his college years at Northeastern University in Boston, where he received two Bachelor’s degrees – one in Information Science and the other in Business Administration. James discovered that his skills in engineering and development were the perfect match for his innate passion to serve others by providing the most user-friendly features possible and keeping the focus on superior customer service. 

His unique understanding of startup dynamics began at a young age, as he learned by watching his father build and sell businesses in multiple industries. He has since been able to apply those lessons, creating particularly marketable and intuitive technological solutions.

positions.title: Principal Frontend Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Leading front-end strategy and implementation using TS + React
- Helping shape AI strategy, including implementation of AI solutions using Conduit, Meroxa's open-source real time data streaming tool for both our customers and internal use (including but not limited to realtime RAG pipelines, realtime sentiment analysis pipelines, realtime moderation pipelines)

positions.title: Lead Engineer
positions.description:
Front-end Engineering Team

Develop features for and maintain Heroku Dashboard using Ember.js Also responsible for building and maintaining Heroku Dashboard APIs using Node, Ruby & Elixir.

positions.title: CTO
positions.description:
- Leading technical strategy at Audioheads
- Full stack web development in Ruby, Javascript, Python, neo4j
- Project management

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Full stack development and maintenance of a rapid prototyping web application using Rails and Ember.

positions.title: Partner
positions.description: Business Development, Web Development, Technology Consulting

positions.title: Service Desk Analyst
positions.description: Implemented new campus-wide information systems, including: new print queue system, management and maintenance of campus computer labs, technical support and phone support for college students, faculty, and staff (all users) using Northeastern information technology.

positions.title: Information Systems Assistant
positions.description: Created, recorded, and executed performance testing scripts, functional testing and bug reporting maintenance for internal financial application.

positions.title: IT Research Analyst
positions.description: Research and preparation of high-level documents and information for lead enterprise architect and chief technology officer, organization and maintenance of team’s research on SharePoint, analyzed new technologies (such as cloud computing and service-oriented architecture) to report their compatibility with current company systems
